title: COSHUMA full affiliate program audit for all registered tools

payload.goal: Audit every currently registered tool in the COSHUMA dataset for an official affiliate/referral/partner program and produce an actionable monetization inventory.
requirements: Read the current main-branch tool dataset first and derive the exact current tool count and IDs; do not assume 151 if main differs.

For every registered tool, search official sources first for affiliate/referral/partner programs. Record official source URL/evidence, program status, network/provider, commission model, cookie duration, payout threshold/method if public, application URL, country/eligibility restrictions, maintenance requirements, and whether joining is free.
Classify each tool as approved_tracking, applied_pending, rejected, blocked_platform_bug, program_exists_not_applied, no_program_found, program_closed, or needs_manual_verification.
Never count a generic homepage/pricing/signup URL as an affiliate link.
Preserve known verified states for Taskade, Systeme.io, Fliki and current pending/rejected/blocked programs unless fresher official evidence changes them.
Prioritize programs that are free to join, recurring/high commission, relevant to COSHUMA traffic, and do not require paid subscriptions or upfront spend.
Return a ranked top 30 application queue and a full per-tool table/inventory in structured JSON.
Zero cost only; no paid tools; no production writes; no account applications in this research task.
